PreInvocation.command: "${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python}" -I -c 'import os, sys; from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path; os.environ["LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON"] = sys.executable; os.execv("/bin/bash", ["bash", str(machinery_path("agy_hooks/pending_orders_inject.sh")), *sys.argv[1:]])'

"${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python}" -I -c 'import os, sys; from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path; os.environ["LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON"] = sys.executable; os.execv("/bin/bash", ["bash", str(machinery_path("agy_hooks/driver_state_inject.sh")), *sys.argv[1:]])' agy-hook

Stop.command: "${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python}" -I -c 'import os, sys; from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path; os.environ["LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON"] = sys.executable; os.execv("/bin/bash", ["bash", str(machinery_path("agy_hooks/driver_state_inject.sh")), *sys.argv[1:]])' agy-stop-hook

hooks.command: "${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python}" -I -c 'import os, sys; from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path; os.environ["LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON"] = sys.executable; os.execv("/bin/bash", ["bash", str(machinery_path("agy_hooks/driver_state_inject.sh")), *sys.argv[1:]])' agy-pretool-hook

hook_root="${LU_PRODUCT_ROOT:-}" && if [ -z "$hook_root" ]; then hook_common="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" && hook_root="$(cd "$hook_common/.." && pwd -P)"; fi && export LU_PRODUCT_ROOT="$hook_root" && LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON="${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$hook_root/.venv/bin/python}" bash "$hook_root/scripts/pre_commit/project_python.sh" -I -m lu_machinery.agent_runtime.secret_print_hook --harness agy || { printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"deny","reason":"BLOCKED by guard-secret-print (#M-5): hook bootstrap failed."}'; printf '%s\n' 'BLOCKED by guard-secret-print (#M-5): hook bootstrap failed.' >&2; exit 0; }
